prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1436; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear bumper cover cracked across the center with the left tail lamp assembly broken and the trunk lid edge pushed inward. The damage pattern is mostly consistent with the impact described, and the spot damage and crush depth match a rear-end strike at low speed. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and the prior repair records reviewed show no repeated charges. The planned repair covers replacing the bumper cover, the tail lamp, and reinforcement bar, with bodywork on the trunk lid edge and refinishing of the affected panels. The labor hours requested fit the damage shown and are reasonable for the scope of work.
